title: Quality
description: This mod adds the Quality enchantment, which allows finding resources of higher quality. Use the new ingredients to craft better tools and furnaces!
body:
This mod adds the possibilty to find items of higher quality (uncommon, rare, epic, legendary). Use items of higher quality to craft better tools, furnaces and more!

### Quality Enchantment
To start gathering quality items, you need to enchant a tool with the quality enchantment. The quality enchantment goes up to level 3, with each level increasing the chance to find higher rarity items.

![Quality enchantment in the enchantment table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a0162832e447b5e9af2369229570fa95745b5d6.jpeg)

Each tool, only has a certain set of items, which can drop with higher quality, e.g. a pickaxe can drop quality cobblestone and ores, a sword can drop quality mob drops, etc.

### Quality Items
The quality of items can be seen on their icon or by hovering over the item in the inventory.

![The player inventory, filled with items of different quality](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/918d4d42421d7cb90e90880a4da3375225020c35.jpeg)

Quality items can be used to craft other quality items of the same rarity.

![Uncommon ingredients are used to craft an uncommon pickaxe in the crafting table.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f08cb7eb8ca988e8bd9e0b5b8043224384e909e3.jpeg)

### Quality Benefits
Items of higher quality might provide various benefits based on the rarity.

![Rare pickaxe (+60% Mining Speed)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4488cadf3866f734aaa35a960474fc4bb944101.jpeg)

![Legendary Blast Furnace (-50% Smelting/Cooking Duration)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfd2b3c747b286bac39d15c05a6b5db8755f8552.jpeg)

**List of Items that benefit from quality:**
- Tools (Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels): increased mining speed
- Swords: increased damage
- Armor: increased armor
- Furnaces: decreased smelting/cooking duration
- Fishing Rods: increased luck
- There is more stuff planned, but idk.
